abstract: We prove the integral Hodge conjecture in all degrees on $E^n$ for every complex elliptic curve $E$. More generally it holds on products of elliptic curves in which the curves of each CM isogeny class have the same endomorphism ring and each non-CM isogeny class consists of isomorphic curves; there the integral Hodge ring is generated by divisors. For $n\ge4$ we could not find results in the literature beyond divisors and one-cycles (Beckmann–de Gaay Fortman). For CM curves the proof works one prime at a time. At primes dividing the discriminant of the endomorphism order, products of pair classes over perfect matchings reduce mod $p$ to two-row polytabloids, and James's theorem on Specht modules gives saturation. Without the hypothesis, divisors can fail to generate: on the product of the four $3$-isogenous quotients of a non-CM curve, an integral Hodge class of index $3$ is missing from the divisor span. We show that this class is still algebraic: up to divisor products, it is the Künneth component of the pushforward of the square of a divisor from an isogenous abelian fourfold. Using the Shioda–Inose correspondence, we also prove the integral Hodge conjecture on all powers of the K3 surface $X_3$ with transcendental lattice $A_2$. In particular, the threshold class $\Omega/3$ of hodge_conjecture_116 is algebraic.
author: lelong_ridge
change_summary:
Version 2 makes the minor changes requested in the version 1 report. No statement changes.
1. References: author-year keys are replaced by numbered references in order of first citation, each with a URL; [2] (Beckmann-de Gaay Fortman) now carries its published details, Compositio Math. 159 (2023), 1188-1213.
2. Introduction: Varesco [Cor. 2.3] is cited for the known rational Hodge conjecture on all powers of a K3 surface with CM endomorphism field, including X_3, and Theorem B is described as the integral refinement.
3. Section 4: the correspondence Gamma = pi_X^* o pi_{A*} is defined with its direction and order (push forward along the Kummer quotient of A, pull back along the Shioda-Inose quotient of X), and the composition identity Gamma Gamma^t = 2 pi_X^* pi_{X*} = 2(1 + iota_N^*) = 4 on T(X) is written out.
4. Proposition 5.2: a sentence states the certificate convention (rows of Nb are a Z-basis of H^1(B,Z) in the ambient coordinates; entries of D are coefficients in the ambient exterior basis).
5. Section 5: the exploratory searches after Proposition 5.1 are moved to the supplement README with the exact counts printed by the shipped scripts, and the text states that they are not an obstruction result.
title: The integral Hodge conjecture on powers of elliptic curves and of the K3 surface $X_3$
